name: Magenta
short: An industrial design studio founded by Ronen Bavli in 1992.
long: Magenta is an industrial design studio founded by Ronen Bavli in 1992. Its work is marked by humour, passion and creative freedom, with an open approach to materials and technology. Industrial designers, artisans and graphic designers work together in the studio.
